text_en: In recent years, online education has played an increasingly important role in college students' lives.
text_cn: 近年来，在线教育在大学生生活中发挥着越来越重要的作用。
note: 万能句型 play an increasingly important role in + 名词；role 后固定用 in，不用 on。

text_en: It is universally acknowledged that we should attach great importance to the protection of the environment.
text_cn: 人们普遍认为，我们应当高度重视环境保护。
note: It is universally acknowledged that 引出共识；attach great importance to 中 to 为介词。

text_en: There is no denying that the number of people who prefer to work from home has increased sharply.
text_cn: 不可否认，倾向于居家办公的人数急剧增加。
note: There is no denying that 表让步式肯定；the number of 后谓语用单数 has，a number of 才用复数。

text_en: Not only does reading broaden our horizons, but it also enriches our inner world.
text_cn: 阅读不仅开阔我们的视野，而且丰富了我们的内心世界。
note: Not only 置于句首要部分倒装 does reading；与 but ... also 呼应；horizons 表眼界时常用复数。

text_en: Only by working hard can we turn our dreams into reality.
text_cn: 只有努力奋斗，我们才能把梦想变为现实。
note: Only 加状语置于句首，主句部分倒装 can we；turn ... into reality 为固定搭配。

text_en: Compared with traditional teaching, online learning offers greater flexibility and saves much time.
text_cn: 与传统教学相比，在线学习提供了更大的灵活性，也节省了大量时间。
note: Compared with/to 作状语时，逻辑主语须与主句一致；flexibility 不可数，不说 a flexibility。

text_en: It is high time that we took effective measures to reduce plastic waste.
text_cn: 我们该采取有效措施减少塑料垃圾了。
note: It is high time that 从句谓语用过去式 took，属虚拟语气；take measures to do sth 为固定搭配。

text_en: As far as I am concerned, the advantages of online shopping far outweigh its disadvantages.
text_cn: 就我而言，网上购物的优点远远大于其缺点。
note: As far as I am concerned 引出个人观点；far 修饰 outweigh 加强语气，outweigh 为及物动词。

text_en: With the rapid development of science and technology, our way of life has changed dramatically.
text_cn: 随着科技的迅猛发展，我们的生活方式发生了巨大变化。
note: With 加名词短语表伴随，是开头段万能结构；dramatically 比 greatly 更书面。

text_en: We should make full use of our spare time to improve ourselves rather than waste it on screens.
text_cn: 我们应充分利用业余时间提升自己，而不是把它浪费在屏幕上。
note: make full use of 意为充分利用；rather than 连接并列成分，此处前后同为动词原形。

text_en: It goes without saying that a healthy diet contributes to both physical and mental well-being.
text_cn: 不言而喻，健康的饮食有益于身心健康。
note: It goes without saying that 引出常识性观点；contribute to 中 to 是介词，well-being 不可数。

text_en: Faced with fierce competition, college students are supposed to develop practical skills.
text_cn: 面对激烈的竞争，大学生应当培养实用技能。
note: Faced with 为过去分词作状语，多用于描写困境；be supposed to 表应当，比 should 委婉。

text_en: The more we practise, the more confident we will become in speaking English.
text_cn: 我们练习得越多，说英语时就越自信。
note: the 加比较级，the 加比较级 表越……越……；主句常用将来时，confident 后接 in doing sth。

text_en: Nothing is more important than striking a balance between work and life.
text_cn: 没有什么比在工作和生活之间取得平衡更重要。
note: Nothing is more ... than 用否定比较表达最高级；strike a balance between A and B 为固定搭配。

text_en: It is widely believed that reading classics benefits us in many ways, especially in shaping our values.
text_cn: 人们普遍认为，阅读经典在许多方面对我们有益，尤其在塑造我们的价值观方面。
note: It is widely believed that 客观引出观点；benefit sb 为及物用法，不说 benefit to sb。
